subject: Assurance coordination: SIG/SOC2/ISO questionnaire — NebulaWorks
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nebulaworks.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebulaworks.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@nebulaworks.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SIG/ISO questionnaire (initial)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the overview yesterday. NebulaWorks is moving forward with our vendor assessment and the SIG + ISO questionnaire is the main packet our security team uses. We've attached the questionnaire (separate upload) and have a few clarifying asks before we start the full crosswalk: 

- We need a single point of contact for evidence drops and timeline expectations.
- For controls that map to SOC 2 and ISO, we prefer a single crosswalk file that shows coverage and evidence links.
- Any controls that are met via third-party providers (e.g., cloud provider key management) — can you mark those and provide the relevant attestation?

Can Sofia or someone on your team confirm who will own the evidence collection? Ideally we can get a plan for the next two weeks.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: nebula-sig-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/ISO questionnaire (initial)

Hi Alex — thanks, and glad the demo was useful. I'll coordinate the response. Quick plan below: 

1) Owner: Jonas Weber will own the control crosswalk and evidence collection.
2) Sprint: We can deliver an annotated SIG crosswalk + SOC 2 coverage summary by 2027-11-10 (two-week sprint). If NebulaWorks needs an earlier tranche we can surface high-priority controls first.
3) Evidence handoff: We'll provide a Drive folder with:
   - redwood-sig-crosswalk-annotated.xlsx (control-level mappings and evidence references)
   - infra-diagram.pdf (network & tenancy diagram)
   - soc2-coverage-summary.pdf (high-level mapping to Trust Services Criteria)
4) Third-party evidence: we'll flag cloud / infra controls and include cloud provider attestation links (e.g., GCP SOC2).

Jonas, can you confirm the internal owners and whether we should include any additional artifacts up-front (configuration snapshots, sample logs)?

--
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/ISO questionnaire (initial)

Thanks, Sofia. Confirming ownership and quick notes from our side: 

- I'll own the annotated crosswalk. Neha will pull artifact-level exports (policy docs, sample config, and log extracts).
- Requested tranche approach sounds good: we will prioritize controls marked "high risk" by NebulaWorks first (please flag those in the questionnaire).
- Evidence types we'll provide: policy PDFs, screenshots of console configs, sanitized log extracts (sample windows), and signed attestations where applicable.

Alex — two questions: 
1) Is NebulaWorks able to accept evidence via a secure SFTP upload, or do you prefer Google Drive links with restricted access?
2) Are there any specific requirements for timestamp formats on log samples? Some enterprise teams ask for UTC with epoch.

Attachment: infra-diagram.pdf (diagram stub)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nebulaworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@nebulaworks.com>, Procurement <procurement@nebulaworks.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/ISO questionnaire (initial)

Thanks Jonas — SFTP preferred for evidence drops (we have a short whitelist for vendor uploads). I'll ask our infra lead to provision an account and share creds out-of-band.

For prioritization: our security team marked ~40 SIG controls as high-priority — I'll upload a small "priority" sheet to the questionnaire and flag those controls by ID.

Timestamps: UTC is preferred; epoch is fine if you include a human-readable column.

One more ask: our legal team wants to see the exact text of any retention or data residency exceptions redwood intends to apply. Can you surface that in the crosswalk as a short note per-control where relevant?

Best,
Alex

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 30 Oct 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/ISO questionnaire (initial)

Hi Alex / team — quick status update and items we need from NebulaWorks so we can hit 2027-11-10: 

Outstanding from NebulaWorks:
- Priority sheet with control IDs (you mentioned ~40 controls) — please attach to the questionnaire or share link.
- SFTP credentials for upload (we'll consume evidence there).
- Any required NDAs / extra-data handling instructions for log artifacts.

What's in the first tranche (deliver by 2027-11-03):
- redwood-sig-crosswalk-annotated.xlsx (first ~15 high-priority controls mapped; evidence pointers included)
- soc2-coverage-summary.pdf (initial coverage matrix)
- sample infra-diagram + tagged notes on where controls are enforced

Notes on redlines/retention: where we rely on short-term caches or ephemeral logs we will call out the retention length and provide options for extended retention via the Dedicated or Private deployment models. We'll include a short per-control comment for any data residency or retention exceptions.

If procurement needs a DocuSign link for our standard DPA, share the DocuSign ID and we'll route it to our legal team.

--
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
